propositions: The documented curl-based commit-msg hook install command uses git rev-parse --git-path which resolves to the shared hooks directory from any worktree, silently clobbering the pre-commit wrapper in the main checkout and breaking Change-Id stamping across all worktrees.

The pre-commit migration mode preserves both the wrapper and Gerrit's Change-Id stamper as separate hooks in a chain, but the documented install replaces the wrapper entirely, breaking the chain and preventing both the pre-commit gate and Change-Id stamping from running.

The failure is silent at commit time and only surfaces at git push gerrit, potentially many commits later and in a different worktree than the one that ran the install command, making diagnosis difficult.

The fix consolidates the install into make hooks with a new scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh that is cwd-independent, resolves the shared hooks directory explicitly, and refuses to overwrite a pre-commit wrapper.
